city:Brazzaville.text: Brazzaville is the capital city of the Republic of the Congo. One million people live there. Brazzaville is on one side of the Congo river, with Kinshasa on the other side.

city:Conakry.title: Conakry
city:Conakry.text: Conakry or Konakry is the capital and largest city of Guinea. The city is a port on the Atlantic Ocean. The population of Conakry is about 2 million people.

city:Yamoussoukro.title: Yamoussoukro
city:Yamoussoukro.text: Yamoussoukro is the capital city of Côte d'Ivoire. About 200,000 people live in this city. Yamoussoukro became the capital in 1983.

city:Ottawa.title: Ottawa
city:Ottawa.text: Ottawa is the capital of Canada and is part of the province of Ontario. It is south of the Ottawa River. In 2004, there were about 808,391 people in the city.

city:Belgrade.title: Belgrade
city:Belgrade.text: Belgrade is the capital city of the country of Serbia. Before the wars of the 1990s, it was the capital of Yugoslavia from 1918 to 1992 after the Kingdom of Serbia collapsed in 1918 along with Austria-Hungary after World War 1.

city:Bandar Seri Begawan.title: Bandar Seri Begawan
city:Bandar Seri Begawan.text: Bandar Seri Begawan is the capital city of Brunei and the largest city. It has a population of 140,000. The city is the home of producers of furniture, textiles, handcrafts, and timber.

city:Sucre.title: Sucre
city:Sucre.text: Sucre is the capital city of Bolivia. It was also known as Charcas, La Plata, and Chuquisaca in the past. About 250,000 people lived there in 2006.

city:Belmopan.title: Belmopan
city:Belmopan.text: Belmopan is the capital city of Belize. There are about 20,000 people living there.

city:Bangui.title: Bangui
city:Bangui.text: Bangui is the capital city of Central African Republic. It is the largest city in the country. The city has a population of 531,763 people.

city:Yaoundé.title: Yaoundé
city:Yaoundé.text: Yaoundé is the capital city of the Republic of Cameroon. It is the second largest city in the country after Douala.

city:Tirana.title: Tirana
city:Tirana.text: Tirana is the capital and largest city of Albania. It is located in the centre of the country, enclosed by mountains and hills with Dajti rising to the east and a slight valley to the northwest overlooking the Adriatic Sea in the distance. It is among the wettest and sunniest cities in Europe, with 2,544 hours of sun per year.

city:Yerevan.title: Yerevan
city:Yerevan.text: Yerevan is the capital and largest city of Armenia. In 2004 about 1,088,300 people lived in Yerevan. Some people write Yerevan as Erevan.

city:Phnom Penh.title: Phnom Penh
city:Phnom Penh.text: Phnom Penh is the capital of Cambodia. It is the largest and most populous city in the country. It is also the capital of the Phnom Penh administrative city.

city:La Paz.title: La Paz
city:La Paz.text: Nuestra Señora de La Paz is the capital of Bolivia, and La Paz Department. It is the second largest city only after Santa Cruz de la Sierra. It is in the western part of the country in the department of the same name.

city:Cotonou.title: Cotonou
city:Cotonou.text: Cotonou is the economy capital of Benin. It is the largest city in that country. The city officially has 761,137 people, but it is thought that the actual number of people living in the city may be as high as 1.2 million.

city:Sofia.title: Sofia
city:Sofia.text: Sofia is the capital and the largest city of Republic of Bulgaria. Sofia means wiseness in Greek language and in Ancient Greek language. It has 1.3 million people.

city:Minsk.title: Minsk
city:Minsk.text: Minsk or Miensk is the capital and a major city of Belarus. About 2 million people lived in the city as of 2021. Minsk is also a headquarters of the Commonwealth of Independent States.

city:Thimphu.title: Thimphu
city:Thimphu.text: Thimphu (ཐིམ་ཕུ་) is the capital city of Bhutan. It is the name of the surrounding valley and dzongkhag, the Thimphu District. It has a population of 50,000 (2003), it is the largest population center in the country.

city:Gaborone.title: Gaborone
city:Gaborone.text: Gaborone is the capital city of Botswana. It has a population of 231,626 people. Gaborone is one of the fastest-growing cities in Africa.

city:Canberra.title: Canberra
city:Canberra.text: Canberra is the capital city of Australia. There are 403,468 people who live there. It does not belong to a state but it is in the Australian Capital Territory (ACT).

city:Ouagadougou.title: Ouagadougou
city:Ouagadougou.text: Ouagadougou (, is the capital of Burkina Faso. It is also the country's biggest city. In Ouagadougou, people mainly make clothing and food.

city:Sarajevo.title: Sarajevo
city:Sarajevo.text: Sarajevo is the capital city of Bosnia and Herzegovina. It has an estimated population of 436,000 people in the urban area including some municipalities from City of East Sarajevo which is the part of Republika Srpska entity. The city has people living in it from many different cultures.

city:Naypyidaw.title: Naypyidaw
city:Naypyidaw.text: Naypyidaw, also known Nay Pyi Taw or Naypyitaw, is the capital city of Myanmar, also known as Burma.

city:Nuku'alofa.title: Nukuʻalofa
city:Nuku'alofa.text: Nukuʻalofa is the capital city of Tonga. It is on the island of Tongatapu.

city:Hargeisa.title: Hargeisa
city:Hargeisa.text: Hargeisa is the largest and capital city of the Republic of Somaliland. It is also the regional capital of the Waqooyi galbeed province of Somalia.

city:Victoria.title: Victoria, Seychelles
city:Victoria.text: Victoria is the capital city of the Republic of Seychelles. It is on the north-eastern side of Mahé island, which the main island of the archipelago. The city was first created as the capital of the British colonial government.

city:São Tomé.title: São Tomé
city:São Tomé.text: São Tomé is the capital city of São Tomé and Príncipe. It is the largest city in the country. The city has a population of 56,166 people.

city:Apia.title: Apia
city:Apia.text: Apia, is the capital of Samoa. In 2001, it had 380,800 people. It is part of the Tuamasaga district. The city is on the northern coast of Upolu Island.

city:Valletta.title: Valletta
city:Valletta.text: Valletta is the capital city of Malta. It was founded by Jean Parisot de la Valette, the Grandmaster of the Order of Saint John on March 28, 1566. The city's population is 6,315 and it is currently decreasing as people move to the UK, Italy, or the newer areas of Malta.

city:Jerusalem.title: Jerusalem
city:Jerusalem.text: Jerusalem is one of the oldest cities in the world that people have lived in continuously.

city:Praia.title: Praia
city:Praia.text: Praia is the capital of the island nation of Cape Verde. It lies on Santiago island in the Sotavento archipelago. The city has, in 2010, a population of 127,832.

city:Nassau.title: Nassau, Bahamas
city:Nassau.text: Nassau is the largest city and the capital of the Bahamas. Nassau is on New Providence Island. In 2008 about 260,000 people lived in Nassau.

city:Nicosia.title: Nicosia
city:Nicosia.text: Nicosia, also known as Lefkosia is the capital city and largest city of the island country of Cyprus. Nicosia is on the Pedieos (Kanlidere) river in the centre of the island. The city is the seat of government as well as the main business centre for Cyprus.

city:Wellington.title: Wellington
city:Wellington.text: Wellington is the capital of New Zealand. It has been the capital since 1865. Before then Auckland was the capital. Wellington is the second largest city in New Zealand.

city:Hanoi.title: Hanoi
city:Hanoi.text: Hanoi is the capital of Vietnam. It is also the second most populated city in the country. In 2023, about 5,253,000 people lived in the city.

city:Ankara.title: Ankara
city:Ankara.text: Ankara is the capital city of the country of Turkey. It is in the center of Anatolia. It is the second most populated city after Istanbul.

city:Budapest.title: Budapest
city:Budapest.text: Budapest is the capital and largest city of Hungary. It was made as such in 1873. In that year, three towns on the River Danube, namely Buda, Óbuda and Pest were united.

city:Sanaa.title: Sana'a
city:Sanaa.text: Sana'a or Sanˤā', is the capital city of Yemen and the capital of Sana'a Governorate, but instead forms the separate governorate of ʾAmānat al-ʿĀṣimah. It had a population of 1,747,627.

city:Bucharest.title: Bucharest
city:Bucharest.text: Bucharest is the capital city of Romania. It is the largest city in the country. The city has a population of 1.9 million people.

city:Damascus.title: Damascus
city:Damascus.text: Damascus is the capital city of Syria. In Arabic, its name is Dimashq (دمشق). It is the largest city in Syria with about 4.8 million people living there.

city:Lisbon.title: Lisbon
city:Lisbon.text: Lisbon is the capital city of Portugal. It is the largest city of Portugal. The city has a population of about half million people.

city:Kuala Lumpur.title: Kuala Lumpur
city:Kuala Lumpur.text: Kuala Lumpur is the capital city and the largest city of Malaysia and a Federal Territory. After Putrajaya was constructed in the late 1990s, the administrative capital has been moved there. Kuala Lumpur has one of the tallest buildings in the world, the Petronas Twin Towers.

city:Havana.title: Havana
city:Havana.text: Havana is the capital city of Cuba. It is the largest city of Cuba and of the Caribbean. Its population was 2.1 million in the census of 2012.

city:Accra.title: Accra
city:Accra.text: Accra is the capital city of Ghana. It has a population of about 1,970,400 (2005). The city is Ghana's largest city. It is also the administrative, communications, and economic center of the country.

city:Tripoli.title: Tripoli
city:Tripoli.text: Tripoli is a city in northwest Libya. It is the capital of the country. More than three million people live in the metropolitan area.

city:Helsinki.title: Helsinki
city:Helsinki.text: Helsinki is the capital city of Finland. Helsinki is the largest city in Finland. 604,380 (31.12.2012) people live in Helsinki, and 1,360,000 live in the Helsinki metropolitan area.

city:København.title: Copenhagen
city:København.text: Copenhagen is the capital city of Denmark. It is also the largest city in Denmark. In 2014, 1,246,611 people lived in the urban area.

city:Abidjan.title: Abidjan
city:Abidjan.text: Abidjan is the largest city and former capital of Ivory Coast. It is the commercial and banking center of Ivory Coast as well as the de facto capital. Yamoussoukro is the official capital.

city:Brasília.title: Brasília
city:Brasília.text: Brasília is the capital city of Brazil. The name is commonly spelled Brasilia in English. The city and its Federal District are in the Central-West region of the country.

city:Brussels.title: Brussels
city:Brussels.text: Brussels is the capital city of Belgium and the European Union.

city:Dhaka.title: Dhaka
city:Dhaka.text: Dhaka is the capital and largest city of Bangladesh. Dhaka is a megacity, and has a population of 10.2 million residents as of 2022, and a population of over 22.4 million residents in Greater Dhaka. It is widely considered to be one of the most densely populated built-up urban area in the world.

city:Luanda.title: Luanda
city:Luanda.text: Luanda is the capital and the largest city of Angola. Its former name was Loanda. It is a main seaport of the country on the Atlantic Ocean.

city:Algiers.title: Algiers
city:Algiers.text: Algiers is the capital of Algeria which is a North African country. It is the biggest city of the country. The white buildings make it commonly referred to as Alger la Blanche.

city:Yangon.title: Yangon
city:Yangon.text: Yangon also known as Rangoon, is the largest city in Myanmar. It was also the capital city until 2006. The city is by a river called Hlaing River, and is close to the sea.

city:Kyiv.title: Kyiv
city:Kyiv.text: Kyiv or Kiev is the capital and largest city in Ukraine. It is in north-central Ukraine on the Dnipro River. Over three million people live there.

city:Tashkent.title: Tashkent
city:Tashkent.text: Tashkent is the capital city of Uzbekistan. It is also the most populated city in Central Asia, with a population of 2,603,000 in 2023. Its name means "Stone City" in English.

city:Madrid.title: Madrid
city:Madrid.text: Madrid is the capital and largest city of Spain. Madrid is in the middle of Spain, in the Community of Madrid. The Community is a large area that includes the city as well as small towns and villages outside the city.

city:Stockholm.title: Stockholm
city:Stockholm.text: Stockholm is the capital city of Sweden. It is also the biggest city in Sweden. It is on the east coast of the country. The city is built on islands, with canals and open water in the inner city.

city:Bangkok.title: Bangkok
city:Bangkok.text: Bangkok is the capital city of Thailand. In 2010, the city had a population of 9,100,000 people. Since Bangkok has more than 55 times as many people as the second largest city, Nonthaburi, it is a primate city.

city:Lima.title: Lima
city:Lima.text: Lima is the capital city, and is considered the most important and largest city of Peru. 75% of the Peruvian economy is handled in Lima. Lima is the industrial and financial center of Peru, and one of the most important financial centers in Latin America.

city:Dakar.title: Dakar
city:Dakar.text: Dakar is the capital city of Senegal. It is on the country's Atlantic coast on the western edge of Africa. The city is a trade seaport for items leaving Africa.

city:Johannesburg.title: Johannesburg
city:Johannesburg.text: Johannesburg is the largest city in South Africa. It is the capital of the Gauteng Province. It was founded on October 4, 1886 and has the JSE Securities Exchange, which is the largest stock exchange in Africa.

city:Amsterdam.title: Amsterdam
city:Amsterdam.text: Amsterdam is the capital and largest city in the European country of the Netherlands. Amsterdam is famous for its canals. Unlike in capitals of most other countries, the national government, parliament, government ministries, supreme court, royal family and embassies are not in Amsterdam, but in The Hague.

city:Seoul.title: Seoul
city:Seoul.text: Seoul is the biggest city of the Republic of Korea, and its capital. Its official name is Seoul Special City. It has a population of 10 million which is about 1/5 of the Korean population and 1/7 of Korea peninsula, and covers an area of 610 km² that is only 0.6% of South Korea.

city:Manila.title: Manila
city:Manila.text: Manila is the capital city of the Philippines. It is one of the largest cities in the Philippines. Manila is on the biggest island of the Philippines, Luzon.

city:Berlin.title: Berlin
city:Berlin.text: Berlin ) is the capital city of Germany. It is the largest city in the European Union by population, with around 3.7 million people in 2024. Berlin residents come from about 190 different countries.

city:Kinshasa.title: Kinshasa
city:Kinshasa.text: Kinshasa is the capital city of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. It is the third largest city in the continent of Africa. About eleven million people live there.

city:Athens.title: Athens
city:Athens.text: Athens is one of the most famous cities in the world. It is the capital city of Greece and the most important financial, industrial, maritime, political, and cultural center of the country.

city:Baghdad.title: Baghdad
city:Baghdad.text: Baghdad is the capital city and largest city in Iraq. It is the second-largest city in Southwest Asia after Tehran. It is the second-largest city in the Arab world after Cairo.

city:Addis Ababa.title: Addis Ababa
city:Addis Ababa.text: Addis Ababa is the capital city of Ethiopia. It is also the political capital of the African Union.

city:Tehran.title: Tehran
city:Tehran.text: Tehran is the capital and largest city of Iran. It is also the capital of Tehran province and the administrative center for Tehran County and its Central District.

city:Buenos Aires.title: Buenos Aires
city:Buenos Aires.text: Buenos Aires is the capital and largest city in the South American country of Argentina. It has its own executive, legislative and judicial powers. It is in the central-eastern region of the country, on the southern shore of the Río de la Plata, in the Pampas region.

city:Kabul.title: Kabul
city:Kabul.text: Kabul is the capital and largest city of Afghanistan.

city:Vienna.title: Vienna
city:Vienna.text: Vienna ; Central Austro-Bavarian: Wean [veɐ̯n]; Viennese German and Austrian German: Wian []) is the capital and largest city of Austria. It is also one of Austria's nine states.

city:Taipei.title: Taipei
city:Taipei.text: Taipei City is the capital city of the Republic of China, known by most people simply as Taiwan. It is the largest city in Taiwan. It has a monsoon humid subtropical climate.

city:Washington, D.C..title: Washington, D.C.
city:Washington, D.C..text: Washington, D.C. is the capital city of the United States of America. It is a federal district. The President of the United States, the United States Congress, the United States Supreme Court and many major national government offices are in the territory.

city:London.title: London
city:London.text: London is the capital and largest city of both England and its surrounding area.

city:Riyadh.title: Riyadh
city:Riyadh.text: Riyadh is the capital and most populous city of Saudi Arabia. It is also the capital of Riyadh Province, and belongs to the historical regions of Nejd and Al-Yamama. It is in the center of the Arabian Peninsula on a large plateau and is home to 6.5 million people.

city:Rome.title: Rome
city:Rome.text: Rome is the capital city of Italy. It is also the capital and largest city in the region of Lazio, and the geographical region of Latium. It is on the Tiber River and has 2.8 million people.

city:Bogota.title: Bogotá
city:Bogota.text: Bogota is the capital city of Colombia. As of 2009, more than 7 million people live in Bogota, which makes it the largest city in Colombia. It is about 2,640 metres above sea level, on a plateau.

city:Santiago.title: Santiago
city:Santiago.text: Santiago is the capital of Chile and the largest city in the country. It has a population of around 7 million people, about 40 percent of the population of Chile. In Chile, people call the city Gran Santiago or Santiago.

city:Singapore.title: Singapore
city:Singapore.text: Singapore, officially the Republic of Singapore, is a sovereign country. It is nicknamed as 'The Lion City', 'The Garden City' or 'The Little Red Dot'. It is an island state at the southern end of the Malay Peninsula in Southeast Asia, between the Straits of Malacca and the South China Sea.

city:Boston.title: Boston
city:Boston.text: Boston is the largest city of Massachusetts in the United States. It was founded in 1630. Boston is one of the oldest, richest and most culturally important cities in the United States.

city:Orlando.title: Orlando, Florida
city:Orlando.text: Orlando is a city in the center of the U.S. state of Florida. It is the county seat of Orange County. It contains 307,573 people as of 2020.

city:Miami.title: Miami
city:Miami.text: Miami is a city located on the southeastern part of the U.S. state of Florida. It is a known tourist stop and it is well known for its Cuban, Puerto Rican and Haitian culture.

city:Los Angeles.title: Los Angeles
city:Los Angeles.text: Los Angeles (L.A.), officially the City of Los Angeles, is the largest city in California, in the United States. There are many ethnicities of people living in the city, and over 18 million people in the Greater Los Angeles region. The city has an area of 460 sq mi (1,200 km2).

city:Houston.title: Houston
city:Houston.text: Houston is the most populous city in the U.S. state of Texas. It is the 4th most populous city in the United States. As of 2020, more than 2 million people lived there.

city:New York City.title: New York City
city:New York City.text: New York, often called New York City (NYC), is the most populous city in the U.S. state of New York, and the largest city in the United States. It is at the southern end of the U.S.

city:Chicago.title: Chicago
city:Chicago.text: Chicago is a city in the U.S. state of Illinois. It is the third largest city in the United States. Chicago, Illinois is the most populated city in the Midwestern United States.

city:Honolulu.title: Honolulu
city:Honolulu.text: Honolulu is the capital city of the U.S. state of Hawaii. It is also the largest city in Hawaii and it has the most important harbor.

city:Sydney.title: Sydney
city:Sydney.text: Sydney is a city on the east coast of Australia which is the capital city of New South Wales. About five and a half million people live in Sydney which makes it the biggest city in both Australia and Oceania.

city:Toronto.title: Toronto
city:Toronto.text: Toronto is the capital city of the province of Ontario. It is found on the northwest side of Lake Ontario behind New York City and Chicago. With a 2021 population of 2,794,356 people, Toronto is the most populous city in Canada and the fourth-most populous city in North America.

city:Rio de Janeiro.title: Rio de Janeiro
city:Rio de Janeiro.text: Rio de Janeiro is the second largest city in Brazil. It is the capital of the state of Rio de Janeiro. Until April 21, 1960, it was the capital city of Brazil.

city:Mumbai.title: Mumbai
city:Mumbai.text: Mumbai is a natural harbour on the west coast of India, and is the capital city of Maharashtra state.

continent:North America.title: North America
continent:North America.text: North America is a large continent in the Northern and Western Hemispheres of Earth. It is to the east of the Pacific Ocean, the west of the Atlantic Ocean, the south of the Arctic Ocean, and it is the northern part of the Americas. The southernmost part is Central America.

country:U.S. Virgin Is..title: United States Virgin Islands
country:U.S. Virgin Is..text: The United States Virgin Islands are a group of islands in the Caribbean Sea. They are currently owned and under the authority of the United States Government. They used to be owned by Denmark.

country:Puerto Rico.title: Puerto Rico
country:Puerto Rico.text: Puerto Rico, or the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, is a U.S. territory in the Caribbean Sea. This means that it belongs to the United States and citizens of Puerto Rico are citizens of the United States as well.

country:S. Geo. and the Is..title: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
country:S. Geo. and the Is..text: South Georgia and South Sandwich Islands are an overseas territory of the United Kingdom claimed by Argentina. They are in the southern part of the Atlantic Ocean. The territory was started in 1985, before that it was classed as part of the Falkland Islands.

country:Br. Indian Ocean Ter..title: British Indian Ocean Territory
country:Br. Indian Ocean Ter..text: The British Indian Ocean Territory is a dependency of the United Kingdom. It includes many small islands in the Indian Ocean. The territory is the seven atolls of the Chagos Archipelago with over 1,000 individual islands – many very small.

country:Saint Helena.title: Saint Helena
country:Saint Helena.text: Saint Helena is an island of volcanic origin in the South Atlantic Ocean at 15°57′S 5°43′W. It is named after Saint Helena of Constantinople. It is part of the British Overseas Territory of Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha, which also includes Ascension Island and the islands of Tristan da Cunha.

country:Pitcairn Is..title: Pitcairn Islands
country:Pitcairn Is..text: The Pitcairn Islands are a group of islands in the southern Pacific. People only live on the second-largest of the four islands. That island is named Pitcairn.

country:Falkland Is..title: Falkland Islands
country:Falkland Is..text: The Falkland Islands are a group of islands in the South Atlantic Ocean, off the coast of South America. They are an overseas territory of the United Kingdom. Argentina disputes this, and claims their sovereignty.

country:Bermuda.title: Bermuda
country:Bermuda.text: Bermuda is a British overseas territory in the North Atlantic Ocean. The land has one main island and 180 smaller islands. Bermuda is a popular tourist place, with mild weather during the winter months.

country:Turks and Caicos Is..title: Turks and Caicos Islands
country:Turks and Caicos Is..text: The Turks and Caicos Islands are two groups of islands in the Caribbean Sea, near the Bahamas. The islands lie southeast of Mayaguana in the Bahamas island chain and north of the island of Hispaniola. Cockburn Town, the capital since 1766, is in the Grand Turk Island about 1,042 kilometres (647 mi) east-southeast of Miami, United States.

country:Montserrat.title: Montserrat
country:Montserrat.text: Montserrat is a Caribbean island and a British Overseas Territory. Officially, the capital is Plymouth, but the government has moved to Brades after Chances Peak erupted, destroying Plymouth in 1995.

country:Jersey.title: Jersey
country:Jersey.text: Jersey is an island in the English Channel off the northwest coast of France. It is a Crown Dependency of the British monarchy. Jersey is a bailiwick.

country:Guernsey.title: Bailiwick of Guernsey
country:Guernsey.text: The Bailiwick of Guernsey is a territory belonging to the British Crown in the Channel Islands. The bailiwick includes the islands of Guernsey, Alderney and Burhou, Herm and Jethou as well as Sark, Little Sark and Brecqhou.

country:Isle of Man.title: Isle of Man
country:Isle of Man.text: The Isle of Man is an island in the Irish Sea, off the coast of Great Britain. Douglas is the capital city. It also has a flag with a red background and 3 armoured legs joined together - "whichever way you throw us, we always land on our feet".

country:United Kingdom.title: United Kingdom
country:United Kingdom.text: The United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, often shortened to the United Kingdom (UK), or just Britain, is a sovereign country in Northwestern Europe. It is a constitutional monarchy of four countries: England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland. Although these are called "countries", none of them are in the UN and they all have to listen to the British King and the British Parliament.

country:United Arab Emirates.title: United Arab Emirates
country:United Arab Emirates.text: The United Arab Emirates is a country in Western Asia. It borders Oman, Qatar, and Saudi Arabia. The capital is Abu Dhabi, and the largest city is Dubai.

country:Ukraine.title: Ukraine
country:Ukraine.text: Ukraine is a country in Eastern Europe. It borders Russia, Belarus, Poland, Slovakia, Hungary, Romania, and Moldova. To the south is the Black Sea and to the south-west is the self-proclaimed Transnistria.

country:Uganda.title: Uganda
country:Uganda.text: The Republic of Uganda is a landlocked country in east Africa. It shares land borders with five countries including the Democratic Republic of the Congo to the west, Kenya to the east, South Sudan to the north, Rwanda to the south-west, and Tanzania to the south. The capital and largest city is Kampala.

country:Turkmenistan.title: Turkmenistan
country:Turkmenistan.text: Turkmenistan, also known as Turkmenia, is a country in South-Central Asia. It has borders with Afghanistan, Iran, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan. It has no ocean but it is on the Caspian Sea to the west.

country:San Marino.title: San Marino
country:San Marino.text: San Marino is a country in Europe. It is one of the smallest countries in the world. It is in Southern Europe and is fully surrounded by Italy.

country:Saint Lucia.title: Saint Lucia
country:Saint Lucia.text: Saint Lucia is a tropical island country in the eastern Caribbean Sea. It is a part of the Lesser Antilles island group, and it is north of the islands of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines and south of Martinique. As of 2010 there are about 174,000 people.

country:St. Kitts and Nevis.title: Saint Kitts and Nevis
country:St. Kitts and Nevis.text: The Federation of Saint Kitts and Nevis, is a federal nation made up of two small islands in the Caribbean Sea. It is the smallest independent country in the Western Hemisphere.

country:Russia.title: Russia
country:Russia.text: Russia, or the Russian Federation, is a country spanning parts of Eastern Europe and North Asia. It has land from the Baltic Sea to the Bering Strait. By total area, it is the largest country in the world, followed by Canada, and the United States or China.

country:Romania.title: Romania
country:Romania.text: Romania is a country in Eastern and Southeastern Europe. It is north of the Balkan Peninsula, on the Lower Danube River. Western Romania is circled by the Carpathian Mountains.

country:Qatar.title: Qatar
country:Qatar.text: Qatar, officially the State of Qatar, is a sovereign country in Western Asia. It is on the small Qatari-Peninsula on the northeastern coast of the Arabian Peninsula. Its only land border is with Saudi Arabia to the south, with the rest of it's territory surrounded by the Persian Gulf.

country:Peru.title: Peru
country:Peru.text: Peru is a country in South America. The capital is Lima. The ruins of Machu Picchu, the Andes mountains, and the source of the Amazon River are all found in Peru.

country:Paraguay.title: Paraguay
country:Paraguay.text: Paraguay, officially the Republic of Paraguay, is a small country in South America. It is landlocked, meaning that it is not next to the ocean. It is bordered to the North and East by Brazil, the West by Bolivia, and the South and Southeast by Argentina.

country:Papua New Guinea.title: Papua New Guinea
country:Papua New Guinea.text: Papua New Guinea is an island country located on the Pacific Ocean. It is the east half of New Guinea island, plus some nearby islands. The capital city of Papua New Guinea is Port Moresby.

country:Panama.title: Panama
country:Panama.text: Panama is a country in Central America. Its official name is the Republic of Panama, and it's most famous for the Panama Canal. Countries bordering Panama are Costa Rica in the Northwest and Colombia in the Southeast.

country:Palau.title: Palau
country:Palau.text: Palau, officially the Republic of Palau, is an island nation. It is in the Pacific Ocean. Palau is 300 miles (500 km) east of the Philippines.

country:Oman.title: Oman
country:Oman.text: Oman, officially the Sultanate of Oman, is a country in the southwestern part of Asia, on the southeastern coast of the Arabian Peninsula. It borders the United Arab Emirates to the northwest, Saudi Arabia to the west, and Yemen to the southwest. The coast is formed by the Arabian Sea to the south and east, and the Gulf of Oman to the northeast.

country:Ghana.title: Ghana
country:Ghana.text: Ghana is a country in West Africa. Thirty-one million people live there; its capital was once Cape Coast, but now it is Accra. It is in Western Africa, bordering the Gulf of Guinea, between Côte d'Ivoire, Nigeria and Togo.

country:Georgia.title: Georgia (country)
country:Georgia.text: Georgia is a country in the Caucasus region of West Asia and Eastern Europe. It is situated on the coast of the Black Sea and borders Russia to the north, Turkey and Armenia to the south, and Azerbaijan to the southeast. It is largely encircled by the Greater and Lesser Caucasus mountain ranges.

country:Gambia.title: The Gambia
country:Gambia.text: The Gambia is officially called the Republic of the Gambia. This country is also known as Gambia. It is a country in West Africa.

country:Gabon.title: Gabon
country:Gabon.text: Gabon, officially the Gabonese Republic, is a country in Africa. It is located on the equator. It has borders with Equatorial Guinea, Cameroon, and the Republic of the Congo.

country:France.title: France
country:France.text: France, officially the French Republic, is a country in Western Europe. It also includes various departments and territories of France overseas.

country:St. Pierre and Miquelon.title: Saint Pierre and Miquelon
country:St. Pierre and Miquelon.text: Saint Pierre and Miquelon is a French overseas collectivity. It is made up of several small islands. They are close to Newfoundland on the eastern coast of Canada.

country:Wallis and Futuna Is..title: Wallis and Futuna
country:Wallis and Futuna Is..text: Wallis and Futuna, officially called the Territory of Wallis and Futuna Islands, is a group of three volcanic tropical islands Wallis (Uvea), Futuna, and Alofi with fringing reefs. They are in the South Pacific Ocean between Fiji and Samoa. One of the islands in the group is named after Cornish explorer Samuel Wallis.

country:St-Martin.title: Collectivity of Saint Martin
country:St-Martin.text: Saint Martin, officially the Collectivity of Saint Martin, is an overseas collectivity of France. It was created on 22 February 2007. It is in the northern parts of the island of Saint Martin and nearby small islands.

country:St-Barthélemy.title: Saint Barthélemy
country:St-Barthélemy.text: Saint-Barthélemy, officially the Collectivity of Saint-Barthélemy, is a new overseas collectivity of France. It was created on 22 February 2007. It consists of the island of Saint-Barthélemy and neighboring small islands.

country:Fr. Polynesia.title: French Polynesia
country:Fr. Polynesia.text: French Polynesia is a French "overseas collectivity" with the particular designation of "overseas country" in the southern Pacific Ocean.

country:Fr. S. Antarctic Lands.title: French Southern and Antarctic Lands
country:Fr. S. Antarctic Lands.text: These Islands are islands owned by France; they are some of the south most inhabited islands in the world. They are in the Southern Ocean or Antarctic Ocean. Residents include visiting military personnel, government officials, research scientists and support staff.

country:Eq. Guinea.title: Equatorial Guinea
country:Eq. Guinea.text: The Republic of Equatorial Guinea is a nation in west central Africa, and one of the smallest countries in Africa. It borders Cameroon on the north, Gabon on the south and east, and the Gulf of Guinea on the west. The country's territory is both on the continent and on islands.

country:Dominican Rep..title: Dominican Republic
country:Dominican Rep..text: The Dominican Republic is a Latin American country on the Caribbean island of Hispaniola; the other country on the island is Haiti. Its capital, and largest city, is Santo Domingo. The national language is Spanish.

country:Faeroe Is..title: Faroe Islands
country:Faeroe Is..text: The Faroe Islands or Føroyar are a group of eighteen islands in the north Atlantic Ocean between Scotland, Norway, and Iceland.

country:N. Cyprus.title: Northern Cyprus
country:N. Cyprus.text: Northern Cyprus, officially the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus, is a de facto state in the northern half of the island of Cyprus. It is internationally recognized as part of the Republic of Cyprus and only Turkey recognizes it as a separate state. Three hundred thousand Muslim Turkish Cypriots live in its 3,335 km².

country:Dem. Rep. Congo.title: Democratic Republic of the Congo
country:Dem. Rep. Congo.text: The Democratic Republic of the Congo, commonly referred to as DR Congo, Congo-Kinshasa or the DRC, is a country in central Africa. It was known as Zaïre from 1971 to 1997. It is the second largest country in Africa by area and the eleventh largest in the world.

country:Congo.title: Republic of the Congo
country:Congo.text: The Republic of the Congo, also known as Congo-Brazzaville, is a country in Africa. Its capital city is Brazzaville. The country was a former colony of France; it became independent on 15 August 1960.

country:Macao.title: Macau
country:Macao.text: The Macao Special Administrative Region is one of China's two Special Administrative Regions.. Macau is a small city in the southern coast in China. Like Hong Kong, Macau also has a large amount of autonomy, with its own passport, currency, economic rules, and constitution.

country:Hong Kong.title: Hong Kong
country:Hong Kong.text: Hong Kong (; Chinese: 香港, Hong Kong Cantonese: [hœ́ːŋ.kɔ̌ːŋ] , literally "Fragrant Port"), officially The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of The People's Republic of China (HKSAR), is one of two Special Administrative Regions (SARs) of the People's Republic of China (the other is Macau).:,

country:Central African Rep..title: Central African Republic
country:Central African Rep..text: The Central African Republic (CAR), formerly Ubangi-Shari, is a landlocked country in Central Africa. It is mostly a plateau or high, flat piece of land about 941 metres above the sea. The CAR covers a land area of about 620,000 square kilometres (240,000 sq mi), and has an estimated population of about 4.4 million as of 2008.

country:Cameroon.title: Cameroon
country:Cameroon.text: Cameroon is a country in Central Africa. Its capital is Yaoundé. The largest city in Cameroon is Douala. The population of Cameroon is about 20 million.

country:Cambodia.title: Cambodia
country:Cambodia.text: Cambodia or Kampuchea is a country in Southeast Asia. It is near Vietnam, Laos, and Thailand. About 13 million people live in Cambodia.

country:Burundi.title: Burundi
country:Burundi.text: Burundi is a small country in Africa. The capital of Burundi is Gitega. The official languages of Burundi are Kirundi, Swahili, French and English.

country:Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso
country:Burkina Faso.text: Burkina Faso is a country in West Africa. It used to be called Upper Volta and the name was changed to Burkina Faso in 1984. The country was once ruled by France, but it has been independent since 1960.

country:Bulgaria.title: Bulgaria
country:Bulgaria.text: Bulgaria is a country in south-eastern Europe, on the Balkan Peninsula. Bulgaria is the south of the River Danube and west of the Black Sea. To the west of Bulgaria are Serbia and North Macedonia, to the south of Bulgaria are Greece and the European part of Turkey.

country:Brunei.title: Brunei
country:Brunei.text: Brunei Darussalam is a country in Southeast Asia. It is located on the northern coast of the island of Borneo and is surrounded on its landward sides by Malaysia. To the north is the South China Sea.

country:Botswana.title: Botswana
country:Botswana.text: Botswana is a country in southern Africa. The capital of Botswana is Gaborone.

country:Bosnia and Herz..title: Bosnia and Herzegovina
country:Bosnia and Herz..text: Bosnia and Herzegovina, abbreviated BiH (БиХ) or B&H, sometimes called Bosnia–Herzegovina and often known informally as Bosnia, is a country in Southeastern Europe, located in the Balkans with an area of 51,197 km2 and 4,600,000 people. Countries around Bosnia and Herzegovina are Croatia, Serbia and Montenegro. The capital is Sarajevo, and other important cities are Banja Luka, Mostar, Bihać, Zenica and Tuzla.

country:Indian Ocean Ter..title: British Indian Ocean Territory
country:Indian Ocean Ter..text: The British Indian Ocean Territory is a dependency of the United Kingdom. It includes many small islands in the Indian Ocean. The territory is the seven atolls of the Chagos Archipelago with over 1,000 individual islands – many very small.

country:Heard I. and McDonald Is..title: Heard Island and McDonald Islands
country:Heard I. and McDonald Is..text: The Territory of Heard Island and McDonald Islands is a territory of Australia. They are islands in the Indian Ocean. They are about two-thirds of the way from Madagascar to Antarctica.

country:Antigua and Barb..title: Antigua and Barbuda
country:Antigua and Barb..text: Antigua and Barbuda is an island nation in the eastern Caribbean Sea on the boundary with the Atlantic Ocean. Antigua and Barbuda are part of the Lesser Antilles archipelago. In 2011, about 81,800 people lived there.

state:Victoria.title: Victoria (state)
state:Victoria.text: Victoria is a state in Australia, in the south-east corner of the country. Its capital, largest and most-populated city is Melbourne. Geelong is Victoria's second biggest city, Ballarat is the third and Bendigo the fourth.

state:Georgia.title: Georgia (U.S. state)
state:Georgia.text: Georgia is a state in the southeastern part of the United States. It is bordered by Florida to the south, Alabama to the west, Tennessee and North Carolina to the north, and South Carolina to the east. All of Georgia's coastline is on the Atlantic Ocean, which borders Georgia to the southeast.

state:Louisiana.title: Louisiana
state:Louisiana.text: Louisiana is a state in the Southern United States of America. It had a population of 4,657,757 people in 2020. The state has a total area of about 51,885 sq mi (134,382 km2).

state:Maryland.title: Maryland
state:Maryland.text: Maryland is a state in the mid-Atlantic region of the United States of America. Its capital is Annapolis, and its most populous city is Baltimore.

state:Minnesota.title: Minnesota
state:Minnesota.text: Minnesota is a state in the Upper Midwestern region of the United States.

state:Montana.title: Montana
state:Montana.text: Montana is a state in the United States. Its capital is Helena, and the largest city is Billings. Montana has many mountains in the western half of the state.

state:North Carolina.title: North Carolina
state:North Carolina.text: North Carolina is one of the 50 states of the United States. The capital of North Carolina is Raleigh and the city with the most people is Charlotte. North Carolina is split into 100 counties, and each county has many cities and towns.

state:North Dakota.title: North Dakota
state:North Dakota.text: North Dakota is a state in the United States. About 780,000 people lived in North Dakota in the year 2020. The capital and seat of government is Bismarck and the largest city is Fargo.

state:Nebraska.title: Nebraska
state:Nebraska.text: Nebraska is a state near to the center of the United States. Its capital is Lincoln and the largest city is Omaha. It touches the states of Wyoming, South Dakota, Iowa, Missouri, Colorado and Kansas.

state:New Jersey.title: New Jersey
state:New Jersey.text: New Jersey is one of the 50 states of the United States of America. It is in the northeastern section of the country along the coast of the Atlantic Ocean.

state:New York.title: New York (state)
state:New York.text: The State of New York, often called just New York, or New York State (NYS) to distinguish it from the city of New York, is a state of the United States and was one of the original Thirteen Colonies, which were the first thirteen states to make up the US.

state:Ohio.title: Ohio
state:Ohio.text: Ohio is one of the fifty states in the United States. Its capital is Columbus, which is also the largest city in Ohio.

city:Melekeok.title: Melekeok
city:Melekeok.text: Melekeok is a state of the Republic of Palau located on the central east coast of Babeldaob Island. The seat of government of the country, Ngerulmud, is located in the state. The state consists of long beaches, hills, steep ridges, rivers, and the largest and only natural freshwater lake in Palau and Micronesia, Lake Ngardok.

city:Port-of-Spain.title: Port of Spain
city:Port-of-Spain.text: Port of Spain is the capital and chief port of Trinidad and Tobago. With a municipal population of 49,867 (2017), an urban population of 81,142 and a transient daily population of 250,000, it is Trinidad and Tobago's third largest municipality, after Chaguanas and San Fernando.

city:Podgorica.title: Podgorica
city:Podgorica.text: Podgorica is the capital of Montenegro. In 2011, the population was 185,937.

city:Djibouti.title: Djibouti
city:Djibouti.text: Djibouti is a country on the eastern coast of Africa. The capital city is also called Djibouti.

city:Saint George's.title: St. George's, Grenada
city:Saint George's.text: St. George's is the capital and largest city of Grenada. The city is surrounded by a hillside of an old volcano crater and is located on a horseshoe-shaped harbour.

city:Manama.title: Manama
city:Manama.text: Manama is the capital city of Bahrain. It is also the largest city in Bahrain, having almost 150,000 residents.

city:Saint John's.title: St. John's, Antigua and Barbuda
city:Saint John's.text: St. John's is the capital of Antigua and Barbuda, an island nation in the Lesser Antilles. St. John's is located on the island of Antigua.

city:Montevideo.title: Montevideo
city:Montevideo.text: Montevideo is the capital and the largest city in Uruguay. It was founded by the Portuguese in 1717. Its best neighbourhood is called Carrasco.

city:Abu Dhabi.title: Abu Dhabi
city:Abu Dhabi.text: Abu Dhabi is the capital city of the United Arab Emirates. It is in the emirate of Abu Dhabi. Abu Dhabi is one of the seven emirates which form the United Arab Emirates(UAE).

city:Ashgabat.title: Aşgabat
city:Ashgabat.text: Aşgabat is the capital city of Turkmenistan. It also spelled as Ashgabat, Ashkabat, Ashkhabad, Ashgabad. Aşgabat has a population of 695,300 (2001) and is between the Karakum desert and the Kopet Dag mountain range.

city:Lusaka.title: Lusaka
city:Lusaka.text: Lusaka is the capital of Zambia. It is also the largest city in that country. It is in south central Zambia on a plateau at 1300 m in altitude.

city:Harare.title: Harare
city:Harare.text: Harare is the capital of Zimbabwe. It is home to over 1.6 million people. It was known as Salisbury from its foundation on September 12, 1890 until April 18, 1982.

city:Dili.title: Dili
city:Dili.text: Dili is the capital of the country East Timor. People from Portugal moved there around 1520. Now, Dili is home to about 150,000 people.

city:Port Vila.title: Port Vila
city:Port Vila.text: Port Vila is the capital city of Vanuatu. Located on the south coast of the island of Efate, it has the country's most important dock and airport, Bauerfield International, making it the nation's economic and commercial center. As of the 2020 census, the population was 49,034.

city:Malabo.title: Malabo
city:Malabo.text: Malabo is the capital city of Equatorial Guinea. It is on the northern coast of Bioko Island. The number of people living there has grown quickly over the past ten years to about 100,000.

city:Tallinn.title: Tallinn
city:Tallinn.text: Tallinn is the capital of Estonia. It is on the north-eastern coast of Estonia and borders the Gulf of Finland. The city is next to many lakes.

city:Lilongwe.title: Lilongwe
city:Lilongwe.text: Lilongwe is the capital city of African country of Malawi. It lies in the center of the country on the Lilongwe river. It is near the border of Malawi, Mozambique, and Zambia.

city:Guatemala City.title: Guatemala City
city:Guatemala City.text: Guatemala City is the capital of Guatemala. It is the largest city in Central America. It has a population of 942,348 in the city itself and 2,945,080 including all the suburbs.

city:Libreville.title: Libreville
city:Libreville.text: Libreville is the capital city of Gabon. It is the largest city in that country. The city has a population of 578,156 people.

city:Suva.title: Suva
city:Suva.text: Suva is the capital city of Fiji. It is on the southeast coast of the island of Viti Levu. Suva became the capital of Fiji in 1877.

city:Bamako.title: Bamako
city:Bamako.text: Bamako is the capital and largest city of Mali. It is on the Niger River, near the rapids that divide the Upper and Middle Niger Valleys, in the southwestern part of the country.

city:Tbilisi.title: Tbilisi
city:Tbilisi.text: Tbilisi is the capital, and the largest city in Georgia. It was founded in the 5th century by the Georgian king, Vakhtang Gorgasali. According to legend, when he was hunting, he killed a pheasant which dropped into hot water.

city:Nur-Sultan.title: Astana
city:Nur-Sultan.text: Astana, Kazakh: Астана), previously known as Akmolinsk, Tselinograd, and Nur-Sultan, is the capital city of Kazakhstan.

city:Vientiane.title: Vientiane
city:Vientiane.text: Vientiane is the capital city of Laos and the city with the largest number of people. It is in the Mekong Valley and over two hundred thousand people live in its central area.

city:Baku.title: Baku
city:Baku.text: Baku is the capital and the largest city of Azerbaijan, as well as the largest city on the Caspian Sea and of the Caucasus region. It is on the southern shore of the Absheron Peninsula. Baku is located 28 metres (92 ft) below sea level, which makes it the lowest lying national capital in the world and also the largest city in the world located below sea level.

city:Malé.title: Malé
city:Malé.text: Malé is the capital city of the Maldives. It has a population of 133,412 (2014). The city is on Malé Island in the Kaafu Atoll.

city:Khartoum.title: Khartoum
city:Khartoum.text: Khartoum or Khartum is the capital city of Sudan.

city:Oslo.title: Oslo
city:Oslo.text: Oslo is the capital city of Norway. It is Norway's largest city, with a population of 709,037 people in 2023. The area near the city has a total population of 1,588,457.

city:Warsaw.title: Warsaw
city:Warsaw.text: Warsaw is the capital of Poland in Masovian Voivodeship. It is also the biggest city in that country. There are about 2,000,000 people living there.

city:Pyongyang.title: Pyongyang
city:Pyongyang.text: Pyongyang is the capital and biggest city in North Korea. Pyongyang is located on the Taedong River about 109 kilometers from its mouth on the Yellow Sea. Pyongyang is a directly administered city with a position equal to that of the North Korean provinces.

city:Dar es Salaam.title: Dar es Salaam
city:Dar es Salaam.text: Dar es Salaam is the largest city in East Africa. It has a population of about 4,360,000 people. The city is also Tanzania's richest city.

city:Dublin.title: Dublin
city:Dublin.text: Dublin is the capital city of the Republic of Ireland, and the biggest city on the island of Ireland. In 2022, there were over 2.13 million people living in the Greater Dublin Area.

city:Monrovia.title: Monrovia
city:Monrovia.text: Monrovia is the capital of Liberia. It is Liberia's most populous city with a population of 1,010,970. The city is named after 5th U.S.

city:Prague.title: Prague
city:Prague.text: Prague is the capital and the largest city of the Czech Republic. 1.4 million people live there.

city:Kuwait City.title: Kuwait City
city:Kuwait City.text: Kuwait City is the capital of Kuwait. It has a population of 2.38 million in the metropolitan area. It is near the center of the country on the shore of the Persian Gulf.

city:Santo Domingo.title: Santo Domingo
city:Santo Domingo.text: Santo Domingo is the capital of the Dominican Republic and is its largest city. It is the oldest European city in the Americas where people have been living since it was founded at the end of the 15th century.

city:Caracas.title: Caracas
city:Caracas.text: Caracas is the capital city of Venezuela. Santiago de León de Caracas was founded by Diego de Losada in 1567. It is where Simon Bolivar was born.

city:New Delhi.title: New Delhi
city:New Delhi.text: New Delhi is the capital of India. It is also a part of the National Capital Territory of Delhi (NCT).

city:Cape Town.title: Cape Town
city:Cape Town.text: Cape Town is the second largest city of South Africa. It is also home to the South African Parliament where the country's representatives assemble.

city:Moscow.title: Moscow
city:Moscow.text: Moscow ) is the capital and most populous city of Russia. The city is on the Moskva River in Central Russia. It has a population of around 13 million people in the city limits, over 17 million people in the urban area, and over 20 million people in the metropolitan area.

city:Mexico City.title: Mexico City
city:Mexico City.text: Mexico City is the capital and largest city of Mexico. It's also the most populous city in North America. Mexico City is located in the Valley of Mexico within the high Mexican central plateau, at an altitude of 2,240 meters (7,350 ft).

city:Beijing.title: Beijing
city:Beijing.text: Beijing is the capital of the People's Republic of China. The city used to be known as Peking. It is in the northern and eastern parts of the country.

city:Nairobi.title: Nairobi
city:Nairobi.text: Nairobi is the capital and largest city of Kenya. Its name comes from The Masaai word 'Enkare Nyorobi' meaning 'place of cool waters'. It is far from the coastline of Kenya.

city:Jakarta.title: Jakarta
city:Jakarta.text: Jakarta, officially the Special Capital Region of Jakarta, is the largest and the capital city of Indonesia. It is on the northwest coast of the island of Java, it has an area of 661.52 km² and a population of 10,562,088 as of 2020. Jakarta has been established for more than 490 years.

city:Cairo.title: Cairo
city:Cairo.text: Cairo is the capital and largest city of Egypt and the Cairo Governorate. The city name can be translated as the one who won.

city:Tokyo.title: Tokyo
city:Tokyo.text: Tokyo is the capital and largest city of Japan. It is on the island of Honshu in the region of Kanto. Tokyo is the center of the Japanese government.

city:Paris.title: Paris
city:Paris.text: Paris is the capital city of France, and the largest city in France. The area is 105 square kilometres, and around 2.15 million people live there. If suburbs are counted, the population of the Paris area rises to 10.7 million people.
